items.title: Bwi naihor gada bisayao
items.customLyrics:
Bwi naihor gada bisayao
Isorni menda bisaya -2
Jerusalemni gwthar lamajwng
Bifa Isorni mwndirao thangw -2
(A)
Halleluiya Hossanna, subungni jiuni raja
Mwndir nonga bi, Isorni saogari
Seler nonga be jiuni malasw -2

items.title: Aya vo jagat mein
items.customLyrics:
Aaya vo jagat mein, paapiyon ko karne paritran
Laya vo jeevan deep sansar ko karne ujjala -2
Marg vahi, satya vahi, jeevan bhi vahi hai -2
(A)
Vo vahi Masi hai jo aane wala
Vo vahi Masi hai jo bachane wala -2
Swarg uska, dharti bhi, sabka vahi hai rakha wala
(B)
Dukh uthaya Prabhu ne, taaki hamen mukti mile
Balidan hua Ishu ne, taise hamen jeevan mile-2
Mukti vahi hai, jeevan bhi, sabka vahi hai rakha wala

items.title: Dihun janai dibosa
items.customLyrics:
Dihun janai dibosa
Jwngni mwnse jarimin
Be jarimin dihun jandwng
Subungkhou fwjakhangnw -2
(A)
Jwng sibigwn khouse janan
“Kristoni gaham batra-2”
Jwng rwjabgwn Kristni methai
“Subungkhou fwjakhangnw-2” -2
(B)
Khonsaibwdwng be dibosa
“Buhumni subung fwrkhou-2”

“Geremsa khwmsali khou-2”
